feeds.title: Techarenan
feeds.description: Full coverage of the latest innovations, business startups, and investment news in Sweden's Tech & Investment space. Techarenan is a platform for entrepreneurship and innovation, with an annual national competition. We also cover startup news on Techarenan News.

feeds.title: EU-Startups » Sweden Startups
feeds.description: Our section on Sweden Startups focuses on reporting the latest Funding News, Interviews, Acquisitions & Mergers, and more. EU-Startups.com is the leading online publication with a focus on startups in Europe. We write about internet and tech startups out of Europe and provide our readers with data-driven analysis, interviews, and startup-related news.

feeds.title: Daily Scandinavian » Sweden Business
feeds.description: Discover Sweden's Business Culture, Market overviews, Tips to invest in local Finance tools, and general industry news. The Daily Scandinavian is an Oslo-based online publication focused on driving amazing results for businesses in Scandinavia or with a connection to Scandinavia.

feeds.title: Elisabet Lagerstedt Blog
feeds.description: Elisabet Lagerstedt is a blogger, entrepreneur, researcher, and the author of two books. She helps business leaders go beyond business as usual to accelerate Better Business and co-create a better future.

feeds.title: Nordic Startup News » Sweden
feeds.description: News, Insights, and Commentary on the dynamic, fast-paced juggernaut of the Swedish Startup Ecosystem. Pick up snippets as well as in-depth analyses of industry trends from business experts. Nordic Startup News is a nonprofit, open-source news platform by and for the Nordic startup community geared towards providing local news in English Language.

feeds.title: Nordic Life Science » Business

feeds.title: Pinteg Blog » Business
feeds.description: Get insights, explanations, and legal expertise into Personal data Management issues and the GDPR. Take part in the digital revolution without compromising your personal integrity. Founded in January 2020, Pinteg is a Legal-Tech company caring about good handling of personal data both for individuals and businesses.

feeds.title: Worldfavor Sustainability Blog

feeds.title: Curamando Blog

feeds.title: Centigo Blog
